_comment: Hand-maintained signature map for tools/producer_chain.py. The tool reads the DECLARED inputs from core/Products.h; this file only says WHERE each product's owner fill lives and WHICH code shapes count as an Acquire-style read (R) or as a private recompute / read outside Acquire (X). Paths are relative to src/VP-V/modules. Regexes run on comment-stripped lines. Not a claim: the tool prints the file:line evidence. Copyright(C) 2026 VP-V contributors, SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only.

kP10gGrainLevel.note: P10g T3 owner fill (GrainLevelModule): reads P10 through the memo's variant Acquire; single-frame law until the temporal passes are costed

kCodingEvidence.note: P16 is a real producer since L-P16 (r2/job1-p16): CPU per-tile owner fill registered in SkeletonModule.cpp, measure in regions/CodingEvidence.cpp; the ProductCatalog.h / product-graph.md row text still says reserved (stale, catalog owner)

kTdBlocks.note: catalog says reserved; the legacy TemporalDetailGpu pass is the only code that computes td.blocks today, so it is scanned

kCodingEvidence<-kCodingEvidence.note: read shape scoped to the owner fill asking for its own previous frame (req.seq - 1, through its SkeletonMemo parameter); Hub::AcquireTiles is the consumer-side Acquire the monitor uses, not the fill's lag-1 read; MakeOwnerFill ignores its memo today, so the declared lag-1 edge is N

kSourceIdentity<-kP5MonitorTiles.note: type-token match only: FrameInput.classical is a monitor snapshot copied by the call site, not an Acquire

kP10GrainSplit<-kP4SourceStats.note: shared dispatcher read; its picture feeds the ownsTap (P10) tap build

kP11RegionBlockStats<-kP4SourceStats.note: P4 reaches the kernel as c.picture, set by the shared dispatcher (generic read, not per product)

kP10GrainSplit<-kP13SourceRing.interim: interim: declared as an input of the P10/P11 GPU passes, but they read the tap plane, not the P13 source-ring view; owner D5 lane (P13-MOVE / CP-A1-D5-P10-CPU-DECODE, refs/128 item 2); documentation tag only: producer_chain.py schedule() does not read it, and slice d (102b JPROD-HELD-SLICES) makes the scheduler ignore it; Registry::Validate still orders on the declaration (P13 has no inputs, so the order is unchanged)

kP11RegionBlockStats<-kP13SourceRing.interim: interim: declared as an input of the P10/P11 GPU passes, but they read the tap plane, not the P13 source-ring view; owner D5 lane (P13-MOVE / CP-A1-D5-P10-CPU-DECODE, refs/128 item 2); documentation tag only: producer_chain.py schedule() does not read it, and slice d (102b JPROD-HELD-SLICES) makes the scheduler ignore it; Registry::Validate still orders on the declaration (P13 has no inputs, so the order is unchanged)

undeclared_external.note: undeclared external view: P2 via FlowOf (decision G-A3, ProductFlags ExternalView)

no_producer_owners.kP0RebaseDecision: held by scaling/rebase (decision record, no skeleton fill); 102b trigger: P6 entrance-ahead producer row below
no_producer_owners.kP6EntranceAhead: OWNER GAP: no lane in refs/129; 102b PRODUCER-NP-P6 (new row): trigger = the entrance-ahead owner fill is scheduled on the skeleton (scaling/rebase, product.entrance)
no_producer_owners.kP10cGrainSplitChroma: L-B2; ProductCatalog flag Reserved, built with C10; 102b PRODUCER-NP-P10C (new row)
no_producer_owners.kQualityPattern: 102b TD-CORE-P15 PRODUCER BUILD (trigger: R2-9 P15-DECL landed + TD phase 1); lane L-B5
no_producer_owners.kQualityPatternCausal: 102b TD-CORE-P15 PRODUCER BUILD (same job as P15); lane L-B5
no_producer_owners.kRefinedField: 102b row 'P3r refined-field binding' (trigger: TD round, doc 99 phase TD-5 after P3b)
no_producer_owners.kTdMemory: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD (new row): TD engine phase 1 (doc 99 TD-P); lane L-B2
no_producer_owners.kTdAnchorPass: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD: TD engine phase 1; lane L-B2
no_producer_owners.kTdAnchorRefs: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD: TD engine phase 1; lane L-B2
no_producer_owners.kTdDelta: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD: TD engine phase 1; lane L-B2
no_producer_owners.kTdMaps: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD: TD engine phase 1; lane L-B2
no_producer_owners.kTdTrailSummary: 102b PRODUCER-NP-TD: TD engine phase 1; lane L-B2

test_only_references.note: GrainSplit::Compute CPU reference only (refs/128 item 5): no production caller; the GPU P11 pass reads P10 through the skeleton. Test-only until the P11 CPU form is needed (102b PRODUCER-NP-TD / L-B5).
